notes.title: Patch 2 - New Voiceover Feature!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/22e6f8034da724e90eed164f384903cf3ec7f740.png"][/img][/p][p]Grifford is (we believe) the first game to put the voice recording capabilities directly into the game.[/p][p]Record, stop, and playback each character line as you play through the game![/p][p]Choose the characters you want to voice; from Erika and Cap to The often clueless Town Guard and the nefarious Dark Cloaks![/p][p]The resulting Audio files are saved in a folder for you to play, to edit, or to share with others.[/p][p]We'd love to hear your voices for the Grifford Cast so please do feel free to share them in our Discord!
[/p][p]Please give us as much feedback as possible so we can improve the feature.[/p][p][/p][p]Other fixes and improvements:[/p][p]- Modified Jinnie's Attack Guitar chord pitch, so that the guitar chords better match the background music.[/p][p]- Chapter 5 minor story tweaks[/p][p]- Tweaked seating heights for certain scenes.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug that allow the priestesses to help out at the end.[/p][p]- Fixed the issue of Locked Locations in the Sewers, if you choose to Heist by Streets instead of the sewers.[/p][p]- Fixed error where - if Jinnie gets the trait: Deferential ('Defense Up' on combat start) then combat may get stuck.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1 - Stats Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello all, based on your feedback during the closed beta, we've added the ability to access your Stats screen while adjusting your build. [/p][p]This means you can now clearly see how your changes impact your build in real time. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/8f777a56cf0ced517ee07398fd29efebc62c1a20.gif"][/img][/p][p]In [b][i]Grifford Academy[/i][/b], you can freely assign and unassign points, making it easier than ever to experiment with different builds and playstyles. [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1][b]Changelog -> 0.1.0[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2]Major[/h2][list][*][p]New Character 'Stats' panel added to the Character Development Screen.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Minor[/h2][list][*][p]Fixing some double spacing in story script.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved camera positioning in Chapter 4 and Chapter 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Added DarkCloaks running in to stop them spawning out of thin air. For C4Ardalla.[/p][/*][*][p]Add a Distractor animation to loading bar.[/p][/*][*][p]CreditPanel prefab updated to remove duplicate Attribution section.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the effect description for Evade as it didn't parse correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed buff value is still given to a character when a trait (personal growth) is just incremented but not awarded.[/p][/*][*][p]Updating main menu buttons.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Chapter 5 where 'Access the ...' quests were being listed in the Quest list on the map. They now have their own icon, and are not included in the quest list.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed error triggered from InputSystem due to null device layout name. This is caused by empty devices in PlayerInput when current active gamepad is being disconnected in wired mode.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Grifford Academy is Now in Early Access!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]The moment has arrived! We're thrilled to announce that [b]Grifford Academy is officially in Early Access![/b][/p][p]We have an exciting roadmap planned as we journey towards our 1.0 launch, and this is where you come in. Your voice and feedback are crucial to helping us shape the future of the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/6454840271c3ca5d3ec178e06a0ec2989844f153.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]ROADMAP[/b][/h2][p][b]Change Personal Weapon's Affinity[/b][/p][list][*][p]Your character's personal weapon adapts to your chosen Affinity, unlocking unique effects based on how you allocate points to your build. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Reroll Shop (Added)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Spend essence and refresh the shop's inventory, discovering new gear that better suits your build strategy. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Recipe Hunting[/b][/p][list][*][p]Help Chuck expand his menu by tracking down rare ingredients across Caldria. Discover his backstory and unlock delicious new dishes along the way. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Speed Up Combats[/b][/p][list][*][p]Skip or fast forward combat animations to keep the action and decisions flowing. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Roguelite Mode[/b][/p][list][*][p]A no-story mode where you dive into a series of escalating battles. Between fights, shop, level up, and push your build to it's limits. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Pet Creature[/b][/p][list][*][p]You know what's missing from Grifford Academy? A pet![/p][/*][/list][p][b]'Insane' Difficulty[/b][/p][list][*][p]Think strategy mode's too easy? Rise to the challenge by bringing your best gear and builds as you face off against even more difficult opponents. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Auto Heal On/Off[/b][/p][list][*][p]A toggle where the only healing comes from item and consumable use. No free heals are given after combat. [/p][/*][/list][p][u][b]Modding[/b][/u][/p][p][b]Voice Over Recording[/b][/p][list][*][p]Ever wanted to do voiceover for characters in a game? We'd love to build a mode that allows you to record any character's voice [i][b]as you play![/b][/i] [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Game Creator[/b][/p][list][*][p]Learn to write story script and add your [i][b]own stories[/b][/i] into Caldria.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]These will be prioritised based on community feedback and team buy-in, during Early Access, and this is subject to change.[/i] [/p][p][/p][p]If you love the world of Grifford Academy, you can be a vital part of its success. Every purchase, right now at an introductory offer of 20% off, directly supports our development team, empowering us to bring our ambitious plans to you. Purchase now and get all future 1.0 updates at no extra cost![/p][p][/p][p]Help us make Grifford Academy the best it can be. Grab your copy today, share your playthroughs, and tell a friend who would love to enroll![/p][p][/p][p]Be part of Grifford Academy's story today - let's build this world together![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Grifford Academy will be arriving a little earlier—here’s why
notes.notes:
[p][b]Grifford Academy will now be launching into Early Access on June 25th,[/b] moving up from our originally announced July 8th date! 

When we first set our July timeline, it was because we weren't sure if we able to hit the original date so we gave ourselves a buffer just in case. We came to the realization that the new date would've landed in the Steam Summer Sale, not exactly the ideal time for indie games like ours to launch. With so many discounted games competing for attention, it wasn't the ideal time for a launch title. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/2378f2b1f60d3cd1c23f820e9a7e0c6312baacf4.png"][/img]

This shift gives Grifford Academy a better chance to find its audience during a key discovery window, and we’re confident it’s ready for players to experience. The past few weeks have been full of polish, feedback, and final touches—and we truly can’t wait to share it with you. 

[b]We're eager to hear your feedback during early access and make Grifford Academy the best it can be.[/b] 
[/p][p]Thank you all so much for your support, wishlist's, and kind words along the way. This is just the beginning, and we’re so grateful to have you with us on this journey.[/p]

notes.title: Grifford Academy is a part of Turn Based Fest!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We're excited to announce that Grifford Academy will be taking part in TurnBased Fest - an event that celebrates strategy and TurnBased titles! We're glad to be taking part alongside a variety of interesting and fun TurnBased games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/ca02e7ba7cdce52c034872171d1ff26440430175.png[/img]

We want to give a big thanks to the #TurnBasedThursday community on Twitter as well as all the wonderful games taking part. You can check them out here: 

https://turnbasedfest.com/

https://twitter.com/TurnBasedThurs


[h1]TurnBased Combat - Exclusive Look[/h1]

notes.title: Devlog #1 - What is Grifford Academy?
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We're the team behind Grifford Academy, an empowering coming-of-age RPG set to release on PC in 2024! We wanted to give you our very first devlog to introduce you to the mystical book realm of Caldria, why we decided to make Grifford as well as news on an upcoming trailer! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/596f3fe8f5c9ceec5592c846189dba8aaa78d8e4.png[/img]

[h2]What is Grifford Academy?
[/h2]
Immerse yourself in Grifford Academy, a captivating RPG set within the mystical pages of a book realm. Shape the destinies of Erika, Viva, and Cap as their personalities evolve through your choices. Will they learn to embrace each other's strengths amidst the challenges they face?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/ec602ad499c07c19bcee9743cf3a3b0f1aca5833.png[/img]

The game will feature: 
[list]
[*] A compelling coming-of-age story following three ragtag teenagers for an enriching family-friendly experience. 
[*] Engagement that sees the player take an active and engaging role in growing and evolving their characters personality.
[*] No steep or intimidating learning curve. This game is built to be accessible, with deep and quick immersion. 
[*] Equally satisfying combat and narrative, with memorable characters and meaningful story. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/16d015ec7e4da0ddef1ec2982903a4278f58a8dd.png[/img]

[h2]Where did the idea of Grifford Academy come from? [/h2]

The idea of Grifford Academy originated when lead developer Paul first introduced Dungeons and Dragons to his kids. Seeing their wide, excited eyes as they went on whimsical adventures, rescuing dragons and catching giant chickens, inspired him to bring this experience to the next level of immersion - video games. 

This game is a love letter to his kids. He hopes that the story of Erika and her friends serves as a gentle guide for anyone finding their way around the frustratingly perplexing, yet beautiful world that is the teenage mind. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/4eb64309040928ae501c596fd555f384fc27885d.png[/img]

[h2]Stay Tuned - Dames 4 Games! [/h2]

Tune in for [b]Dames 4 Games at 10:00AM PST March 6th on The Mix's YouTube or Twitch channels![/b] We will be showing off a brand new trailer for Grifford Academy to celebrate the showcase. Thanks for Dames 4 Games for involving us in this wonderful show! 

The inaugural Dames 4 Games show will feature interviews with women who work in the industry, women who love gaming, and those who aspire to make a change. The showcase will also highlight upcoming games, gameplay and trailers.

notes.title: Grifford Academy | Game Overview
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/f0dc79dae5024b3019ed227ca4e9b705b15718c3.png[/img]

[i]In this epic coming-of-age single-player RPG, secrets lie buried deep within Caldria's dark heart. Enter the arcane pages of the Book of Caldria, and guide Erika and friends as they navigate this mystical land, confronting its enigmatic inhabitants and facing menacing creatures.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44217115/0ebecbfd4f839eb83ed1b3aa04c13cd9a3274bc1.png[/img]

[b]Story-rich RPG Adventure:[/b] Travel and battle together with companions in this single-player experience. Listen to the banter between Erika and friends - join the fray!

[b]Engaging Turn-Based Combat:[/b] Unleash devastating status effects on foes, while empowering your team with positive buffs in challenging turn-based combat. Utilize a diverse collection of items, to weaken enemies or bolster defenses. 

[b]The Artificer's Surprises:[/b] Explore the diverse and constantly changing inventory of the Artificer, where unique items await your team.

[b]A Breathing World:[/b] Interact with Caldria's inhabitants to unlock new challenges and quests, unveiling unforeseen paths to explore.

[b]Character Affinity Customization: [/b]Maximize your character's general and item affinities to craft a unique and powerful hero. Reset and experiment as you desire.

[b]Evolving Characters:[/b] Witness your character's personality grow and evolve as you help to make decisions along their journey.

[b]Self-Discovery and Friendship: [/b]Immerse yourself in an enchanting narrative that emphasizes the value of friendship and self-discovery.

[b]Intuitive Gameplay:[/b] Enjoy an accessible RPG experience with a user-friendly combat system that allows for deep gameplay.

[b]Enriching Family-Friendly Experience:[/b] Join three ragtag teenagers on their riveting journey, providing a heartwarming adventure suitable for all ages.
